papers.title_en: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
papers.authors: Zeyun Deng, Yuzhe Lu, Yawei Wang, Linbo Liu, Qing Ping, Han Ding, Guande Wu, Panpan Xu, Jun Huan
papers.evidence: 面向策略优化的GRPO奖励细化，可应用于图像生成强化学习
papers.tldr: GRPO在VLA策略强化学习中免训练critic，但二进制成功奖励使同成功/失败组零优势被丢弃，早期多数失败浪费采样。Prism-GRPO引入加权轨迹执行质量分数，将同结果组拆分为质量谱，保留成功优先并恢复训练信号，且证明不增加组丢弃概率。在四类RoboTwin任务中，同等预算下提升成功率，最多节省56% rollout，并抑制奖励黑客，迁移至真机表现更干净。该框架为VLA优化提供了无需任务特定奖励的高效信号增强方案。
papers.abstract_en: GRPO is increasingly used for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies because, unlike PPO, it does not require training a critic. This simplification comes with a sampling cost: group-relative advantages require multiple rollouts from each scene. Under binary success rewards, groups whose rollouts all succeed or all fail have zero advantage and are discarded by dynamic sampling. These groups are especially common early in training, when most rollouts fail, wasting much of the expensive robotic rollout budget. We introduce Prism-GRPO, which augments binary outcome reward with a weighted trajectory-level execution-quality score. By splitting same-outcome groups into a quality spectrum, Prism-GRPO recovers training signal while ensuring that every success still outranks every failure. Quality scores can be derived from simulator contacts, executed actions, or visual observations, avoiding task-specific progress rewards. We prove that Prism-GRPO never increases the probability that a sampled group is discarded for having zero advantages, and derive a gradient-alignment condition under which its combined update remains a local ascent direction for task success. Across four RoboTwin tasks spanning different horizons and coordination patterns, Prism-GRPO improves success and quality at matched rollout budgets and reaches target success rates with up to 56% fewer rollouts. It also suppresses a reward-hacking shortcut, with the cleaner behavior transferring under direct deployment to a real robot. Through ablations, we show consistent gains across contact-, smoothness-, and VLM-derived quality signals.

papers.title_en: Accelerating Visual On-Policy Distillation with Batched Speculative Jacobi Rollouts
papers.authors: Bingqi Shan, Zhehao Yu, Kenhong Lin, Baoquan Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向视觉自回归图像生成的在线策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 视觉在线策略蒸馏（OPD）训练紧凑自回归模型时，在线轨迹生成仍采用逐token自回归解码，导致训练成本高。推测雅可比解码（SJD）可并行解码，但原方法仅支持单序列。本文提出HB-SJD，一种批量SJD rollout后端，允许各图像独立推进，同时通过批量前向验证，并在图像完成时切换Full/Compact执行以降低开销。实验表明，HB-SJD显著减少rollout和端到端训练时间，且不损害学生生成质量，可直接替换现有rollout后端。
papers.abstract_en: Visual on-policy distillation (OPD) improves the training of compact visual autoregressive models by learning from trajectories generated by the current student. However, these online rollouts are still produced token by token with autoregressive decoding, which adds substantial cost to every on-policy training step. Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) provides an alternative because it can process multiple tokens in parallel without an auxiliary draft model, but the original method is designed for single-sequence inference. We introduce HB-SJD, a batched SJD rollout backend for visual OPD. HB-SJD allows each image to advance independently according to its own decoding progress, while images at different sequence positions are still verified in batched model forwards. As images finish, HB-SJD switches between Full and Compact execution to reduce the cost of later rollout rounds. HB-SJD only replaces the student rollout backend and leaves the teacher, distillation objective, and optimization procedure unchanged. Experiments with LlamaGen show that HB-SJD substantially reduces rollout and end-to-end training time while preserving the generation quality of the distilled student.

papers.title_en: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
papers.authors: Poomphob Suwannapichat, Boonyarit Changaival, Caesar Wu, Pascal Bouvry
papers.evidence: RLHF式奖励引导的自回归生成，可迁移至图像生成
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体系统在复杂推理任务中性能优异，但通信拓扑设计常导致token消耗巨大。现有自回归图生成方法ARG-Designer虽能自动设计拓扑，其训练目标却未显式激励稀疏性。为此，受RLHF启发提出RGA-Designer，训练联合建模任务正确性与结构紧凑性的奖励模型，并以该奖励信号微调生成器。在保持任务准确率的同时，平均削减20.5%的token消耗，实现了更高效的通信拓扑生成。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
